parts.name: trunk_areca
sources: The base is a little wider than the trunk (an estimate).
A bright green crown shaft of about 55 by 15 cm (Staples and Bevacqua, 2006).
A frond is 1 to 2 m long (an estimate).
A small crown of about 8 to 12 fronds (an estimate).
10 to 20 m at maturity, at the most 30 m (Staples and Bevacqua, Areca catechu, Species Profiles for Pacific Island Agroforestry, 2006): a palm of 12 m (an estimate).
The leaflets are 30 to 70 cm long and 3 to 7 cm wide, the longest near the middle of the frond (Staples and Bevacqua, 2006).
A fruit is about 5 cm long (an estimate).
A bunch of many red-orange fruits under the crown shaft (Staples and Bevacqua, 2006); the count in the model is an estimate.
A single slender trunk, green and then gray, with white leaf scars; the crown shaft is about 15 cm across (Staples and Bevacqua, 2006). The width of the trunk is an estimate from the crown shaft.
